annotations.title: utilpeek: sort, dedupe and clean up lines of text

description: utilpeek: Sort, dedupe, trim, shuffle or number the lines of a text. For find and replace use text_replace. Returns the text's lines transformed by `operations` in order: trim, remove_empty, dedupe (keeps the first), sort (lexical, natural or length; stable), reverse, shuffle (seeded, repeatable) and number; optionally the most frequent lines with counts. At most 200,000 lines. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.

case_insensitive.description: dedupe / sort / count compare casefolded lines.
case_insensitive.title: Case Insensitive

count_unique.description: Also return the most frequent lines with counts.
count_unique.title: Count Unique

descending.description: For sort: largest first (default false: ascending).
descending.title: Descending

number_separator.description: For number: text between the number and the line (at most 10 characters; default ". ").
number_separator.title: Number Separator

number_start.description: For number: the first line's number (-1,000,000 to 1,000,000; default 1).
number_start.title: Number Start

operations.description: Applied in order: trim, remove_empty, dedupe, sort, reverse, shuffle, number.
operations.title: Operations

seed.description: Shuffle seed: same seed, same order.
seed.title: Seed

sort_mode.description: For sort: lexical (default, by character), natural (numbers by value: item 9 before item 10) or length (shortest first).
sort_mode.title: Sort Mode

top_n.description: With count_unique: how many of the most frequent lines to return (1-1000, default 100).
top_n.title: Top N
